name: Staxuira

abilities.name: Slash
abilities.description: Staxuira deals moderate-high physical damage with his claws.

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.description: Staxuira uses both hands to slash you with his claws, dealing moderate physical damage twice.

abilities.name: Shadow Bolt
abilities.description: Staxuira fires a single bolt of dark magic at you, which deals moderate-high magic damage.

abilities.name: Shadow Strike
abilities.description: Staxuira teleports behind you and strikes you hard, dealing high physical damage. This can be blocked to stagger GStaxuira.

abilities.name: Planar Eruption
abilities.description: Staxuira jumps in the air before crashing down, dealing high magic damage and knocking back targets hit.

abilities.name: Coldharbour Meteor
abilities.description: Staxuira makes a meteor fall on a target, dealing moderate-high flame damage.

abilities.name: Open Portal
abilities.description: Staxuira opens two shadowy portals. Winged Twilights with average health occasionally come out of them.

abilities.name: Replenishing Portal
abilities.description: Staxuira morphs into a shapeless shadow and enters one of his portals. He sits inside the portal to heal, making him untargetable and undamageable. He heals for 0,2% of its Max Health each tick (10,349) and heals for 11 ticks, so 113,839 Health in total. He then exits the portal, which is then consumed and disappears.

abilities.name: Annihilate
abilities.description: Staxuira becomes invulnerable while casting a blue ray on a target, dealing continuous direct low magic damage and snaring in an area, with the first ticks increasing the damage.

notes: Staxuira shares the same model as Rakkhat. The Rakkhat's Voidmantle antiquity released in 2025 retroactively stated that only one Fang of Lorkhaj (such as Rakkhat) can exist at a time, so it is unlikely that Staxuira is a Fang of Lorkhaj but rather another powerful dro-m'Athra in a Grievous Twilight-like form.
summary: Staxuira is a dro-m'Athra resembling a Grievous Twilight who can be found on Gorne. He is located within a small cave at the end of a short dead-end passageway in the center of the southern portion of the dungeon. He serves as one of the champions of the Gorne public dungeon.
